Perfect! The Tour of Heroes dashboard is now complete and builds successfully. Here's what was implemented:

## Summary

I've built a fully functional Tour of Heroes dashboard with:

### **Dashboard Component** (`src/app/dashboard/dashboard.ts`)
- **Search box** with real-time hero filtering (case-insensitive name matching)
- **Top 4 heroes** displayed as a responsive card grid (4 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile)
- Each card shows hero name and ID, with hover effects
- All cards and search results link to hero detail routes (`/detail/:id`)

### **Hero Service** (`src/app/heroes/hero.service.ts`)
- In-memory list of 12 heroes (Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman, Flash, Aquaman, Green Lantern, Hawkman, Cyborg, Martian Manhunter, Green Arrow, Black Widow, Hawkeye)
- Methods: `getHeroes()` and `getHero(id)`

### **Hero Detail Component** (`src/app/hero-detail/hero-detail.ts`)
- Displays hero information from route parameter
- Shows "Hero Not Found" if ID doesn't exist
- Styled card layout matching dashboard design

### Technical Implementation
- ✅ Uses Angular v22+ signals and computed properties for reactive state
- ✅ Standalone components with proper imports
- ✅ `hlmInput` spartan primitive (no raw HTML controls)
- ✅ Native control flow (`@if`, `@for`)
- ✅ Responsive TailwindCSS + SpartanNG styling with semantic tokens
- ✅ Lazy-loaded routes
- ✅ **Build succeeds cleanly** with no errors

The app is ready to run. Navigate to the dashboard to see the top 4 heroes, search by name, and click any hero to view their detail page.
